messages:
marcus: Heads-up — we should run a partner metering backpressure simulation before the HW partner go-live. worried about TTL drops and phantom negative credits if batches get delayed > 2h.
ella: +1. can we model both bursty device retries and partner-side queueing?
pranav: propose two scenarios: (1) partner sends bursts causing our ingest queue to hit backpressure and drop to tiered fallback, (2) partner retries after network partition producing duplicates within TTL.
marcus: exactly. goal: quantify how many 5xxs -> fallback credits we would issue, and how many late-arrivals end up outside the 24h attribution window.
ingest-bot: scheduled simulation job queued: job_id=sm-2026-03-24-001, dataset=acme-device-minutely, workload_variants=burst,partition,replay
sara: can infra spin up a replay cluster with identical batching config (batch_size=512, max_wait_ms=20) so it's realistic? devops: will need a replicant ingest node set with identical kv-store latency profile.
oliver: I can seed partner test harness to emit the edge-case headers: X-Usage-Ts (device), X-Signature, X-Retry-After. will add jitter to timestamp to simulate clock drift.
pranav: include two dedupe windows: 10m (current) and 60m (conservative) to see sensitivity. also test idempotency key truncation edgecases.
kevin: FYI — marketplace contract says partner has 2h grace for late ingest for entitlements activation. we should model both 2h and 24h policies and compare exposure.
ella: checklist: 1) dataset snapshot + synthetic drift 2) replay harness config 3) ingest node latency knobs 4) metric dashboards (late-arrivals, negative-credit-events, fallback-model-invocations) 5) runbook update draft
marcus: i'll own runbook draft. sara/oliver please coordinate replay harness. pranaV (typo? prAnav) — can you own metrics/observability queries? :pray:
pranav: on it. I'll add alert thresholds: late_arrival_rate > 0.5% and duplicate_rate > 0.2% trigger paging.
sara: infra note — need to simulate partner backoff semantics correctly. some partners exponential backoff with jitter up to 30m. will add that.
devops: for the ingest cluster we'll throttle connection accept rate and introduce artificial S3 KV read latency to mimic degraded control plane.
oliver: sample emit payload (for the harness):
```
POST /v1/partner/usage HTTP/1.1
Host: ingest.partner.test
Content-Type: application/json
X-Partner-Id: edgeco-01
X-Usage-Ts: 2026-03-24T12:34:56Z
{
  "device_id": "edge-abc-123",
  "window_minutes": 1,
  "tokens": 125
}
```
marcus: nice. also include a malformed-signature case to test rejection metrics.
kevin: once we have simulation, legal wants a short appendix showing expected credit exposure under each policy for the contract negotiation.
pranav: i'll produce a small table in the simulation output: {policy, late_credits, false_negative_entitlements, duplicates_credited}.
ella: timeline? we should have a dry-run by EOD Fri and a full 24h run early next week.
sara: ack — infra can provision today, but need approval to run partner-harness traffic on staging (rate-limited).
marcus: approved. @devops please limit to 10% of staging capacity and tag traffic. :white_check_mark:
devops: will do. scheduling window 0300-0600 PT to avoid noisy metrics.
oliver: will post harness config when ready.
marcus: thanks all — once we have results i'll spin up a short partner-facing note summarizing risks and the runbook changes.
kevin: thanks, team. :thumbsup:
ingest-bot: job sm-2026-03-24-001 started at 2026-03-24T03:05:12Z, harness=partner-backpressure-v2, expected_duration=2h
